What is the difference between a list, a set and a dictionary?

Supplied answer
A list is an ordered collection that allows duplicates and is accessed by index. A set is an unordered
collection with no duplicates and no indexing, used for membership tests and removing duplicates. A
dictionary stores key-value pairs, keys must be unique and immutable, and lookup is by key. Set and dict
lookups are O(1) on average; searching a list is O(n).
